confidence.rationale: Observed in Macro-Mission 02.1: root test collection imported a legacy NVIDIA probe and a legacy supervisor probe before any test body ran.

decision_rules: Collection and import must be side-effect free before any fixture or test body is available.

evidence_refs.claim: The default collection boundary is enforced before dangerous test modules are imported.
External probes collect safely, remain opt-in, and accidental egress is blocked.

failure_modes: A top-level test statement instantiates a provider, reads a credential, starts a runtime, or calls network during collection.

notes: Risk-based depth now includes pre-collection safety, not only test-body coverage.

preconditions: The repository has tests that import providers, runtimes, SDKs, or credential-aware modules.
procedure: Load a root collection guard before test modules.
Make external probes explicit and opt-in.
Run protected collection before the broader suite.
Record any excluded probe with owner, reason, and re-entry condition.
recovery: Quarantine the importing probe, preserve maintained unit coverage, and rerun collection under the default fail-closed boundary.
stop_conditions: Do not claim collection safety from a green test body if import can execute first.
Do not authorize external collection by test name alone.
summary: Test collection and import must not initiate providers, network, credentials, runtime, or persistence before explicit opt-in.
title: Test collection must be side-effect free
validation: Default root collection passes without importing legacy runtime probes.
